ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are three numbered circular-arc trajectories in the figure. Curve 1 is on the left side, with the largest radius; Curve 2 is also on the left side, with a radius smaller than Curve 1; Curve 3 is on the right side, with a relatively small radius. Near the particle entry point there is a downward velocity arrow, and in the background there is a dot array representing the magnetic field. Reasoning: The problem states that α particles, protons, and electrons enter the same magnetic field perpendicularly at the same speed. The positively charged α particles and protons should deflect to the same side, so Curve 1 and Curve 2 on the left side are candidate trajectories for the α particle/proton; the electron is negatively charged and will deflect in the opposite direction, corresponding to Curve 3 on the right side. The orbital radius of a charged particle in a magnetic field is r = mv/(|q|B). When the speed and magnetic field are the same, the radius is proportional to m/|q|. The mass of an α particle is about 4 times the proton mass, and its charge amount is 2e, so its m/q is 2 times that of the proton, and the radius should be 2 times that of the proton. Therefore, the left-side Curve 1 with the larger radius is the α particle, and the left-side Curve 2 with the smaller radius is the proton. Final answer: Curve 2.

method.method_draft: Describe the three labeled curves and compare their bend directions and radii. Use the fact from the text that alpha particles, protons, and electrons all enter perpendicularly with the same speed. Since the two positively charged particles must bend the same way, identify curves 1 and 2 as alpha/proton candidates. Among these, the alpha particle has twice the proton's radius because m/q is larger, so the larger same-side curve is alpha and the smaller same-side curve is the proton. Therefore the proton follows Curve 2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三条带编号的圆弧轨迹。曲线1在左侧，半径最大；曲线2也在左侧，半径比曲线1小；曲线3在右侧，半径较小。粒子进入点附近有一支向下的速度箭头，背景中有表示磁场的点阵。推理：题目说明α粒子、质子和电子以相同速度垂直进入同一磁场。带正电的α粒子和质子应向同一侧偏转，因此左侧的曲线1和曲线2是α粒子/质子的候选轨迹；电子带负电，会向相反方向偏转，对应右侧曲线3。带电粒子在磁场中的轨道半径 r = mv/(|q|B)。在速度和磁场相同的情况下，半径与 m/|q| 成正比。α粒子的质量约为4倍质子质量、电荷量为2e，所以它的 m/q 是质子的2倍，半径应为质子的2倍。因此左侧半径较大的曲线1是α粒子，左侧半径较小的曲线2是质子。最终答案：Curve 2。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct physics-identification route: it uses the visual ordering of curvature and side of deflection, combined with the magnetic-radius formula, to assign each particle type to a labeled curve.
planner_metadata.image_role: First describe the image: the field region is shown with dot symbols and three circular trajectories labeled 1, 2, and 3. Curves 1 and 2 bend to the same side, with curve 1 having the larger radius and curve 2 the smaller radius among those two; curve 3 bends to the opposite side and is the tightest/smallest loop.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the incoming stream contains alpha particles, protons, and electrons, all entering the magnetic field perpendicularly at the same speed, and that the task is to identify the proton trajectory.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For motion perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field, the circular radius is r = mv/(|q|B). At the same speed in the same field, alpha particles have radius proportional to 4mp/2e = 2mp/e, protons to mp/e, and electrons to me/e, so the proton radius is smaller than the alpha radius but vastly larger than the electron radius. Positive particles deflect in the same direction; electrons deflect oppositely.
